newsitem.title: CHINA: China province executes 22 in crackdown on crime.
newsitem.headline: China province executes 22 in crackdown on crime.

text.p: Authorities in south China executed 22 people last week as part of the "strike hard" crackdown on crime, an official newspaper said.
The executions were carried out last Thursday shortly after court sentencing in Guiyang, capital of Guizhou province, the Guizhou Daily said in an edition seen in Beijing on Tuesday.
The newspaper gave no details of the crimes, saying only they were serious.
It also said the "strike hard" campaign had dealt lawbreakers a severe blow and helped improve social stability.
Authorities in Guizhou executed eight prisoners convicted of taking part in a jailbreak in November, state media had said previously.
China has executed more than 1,000 people in recent months under its latest crackdown on crime.
